The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE HORANA URBAN COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the Office of return member of Horana Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which Sandanam Jonson Paul the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A (1) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Horana Urban Council who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days,
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Rajeewa Wasula Gunasekara to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Wannakuwatta Wadugu Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, returning Officer of the Horana Urban Council acting in terms of Section 66A (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Rajeewa Wasula Gunasekara was selected as the member of the Horana Urban Council.
Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, Returning Officer, Horana Urban Council. District Elections Office,Kalutara,31st July, 2025.
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
